description: This Java class 'ShipmentWorker' provides utility methods for handling shipment-related calculations and operations within the Apache OFBiz framework, including package weight calculation, package splitting based on weight constraints, and retrieving shipment package content values.

classes.name: ShipmentWorker
classes.description: Final utility class providing shipment-related calculations and operations within OFBiz.

methods.name: getShipmentPackageContentValue
methods.description: Calculates the total value of a shipment package content based on related item issuances and order items.

methods.name: getPackageSplit
methods.description: Splits shippable items into packages based on maximum weight constraints.

methods.name: calcPackageWeight
methods.description: Calculates the total weight of a package, converting units to pounds if necessary.

methods.name: getProductItemInfo
methods.description: Retrieves product information from a list based on productId.
